name: exa
description: Search and fetch web content through Exa's remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Web search and page retrieval through Exa MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Exa's Streamable HTTP MCP server. Authentication reads EXA_API_KEY from the local user environment; no secret is stored in this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use Exa to search the web or fetch a page when another search provider is unavailable.
